I couldn’t make any friends there, I felt extremely alone on some days and, apart from that, I hated what I was studying at college. I didn’t know how to handle these endless moments of loneliness (combined with a and I just started to eat a lot as a coping mechanism: I ate 4-5 times a day, fast-food every week and an exaggerated amount of sweets and chocolate daily. There’s no wonder I’ve gained around 10 kilos in less than 6 months. I feel very guilty for this and I wish I had motivation and energy for going to the gym, but I feel so tired every day. Of course, my family noticed I’m fat and I have a lot of acne on my face due to unhealthy food. Having to accept rude and blunt comments is what bothers me the most. My sister’s husband keep asking me how many kilos I have (“70, 75 or more?”), why I don’t go to the gym, why I eat so much and many other “why”s and “what”s. WIBTA for telling me he’s a jerk and he should stop with this bullshit because it affects me? I know fat acceptance is a bullshit and you shouldn’t encourage someone to tolerate their harmful lifestyle, but it does affect me.
